手動選擇模式：自己勾選要當資料夾的條目，最靈活: Manual selection: choose entries to use as folders
標準模式：從一個標頭開始，摺疊其後的所有項目: Standard mode: fold all entries after a header
包覆模式：標頭依序兩兩配對，包住中間內容（不需同名）: Sandwich mode: pair headers in order around the entries between them (names need not match)
點擊後，每個條目旁會出現勾選框，完成後透過懸浮面板確認或取消: Click to show checkboxes beside entries, then confirm or cancel using the floating panel
會複製：摺疊模式、分組設定、手動選擇的資料夾: Copies: folding mode, group settings, and manually selected folders
確定重設所有設定？無法復原喔。: Reset all settings? This cannot be undone.
請勾選要當資料夾的條目，完成後點擊「完成」: Select entries to use as folders, then click Done
請先選擇要複製的預設設定檔: Select a preset to copy first
確定要從「${0}」複製配置到目前預設設定檔嗎？: Copy settings from “${0}” to the current preset?
介面支援繁中、簡中、英文，跟著 SillyTavern 的語言切換: The interface supports Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, and English, following the SillyTavern language setting
fix: 修正停用群組後，角色描述、世界書仍會送出，且被移到最後面的問題。: Fix: Prevent character descriptions and world info from being sent and moved to the end when their group is disabled.
fix: 修正每次畫面重繪都會儲存 preset，以及分組後清單標題列消失的問題: Fix: Avoid saving the preset on every redraw and preserve the list header after grouping.
perf: 拖曳排序時不再反覆重建分組，減少卡頓。: Performance: Avoid repeatedly rebuilding groups while dragging entries to reduce lag.
feat: 版本資訊的作者連結改為 Rainori 作品集。: Feature: Link the author in the version information to the Rainori portfolio.
fix: 修正包覆模式完全無法摺疊的問題（配對邏輯從比對同名改為按順序兩兩配對）: Fix: Restore folding in sandwich mode by pairing headers in order instead of by name.
fix: 修正修改分隔符號後不會即時生效的問題，改為彈出確認面板套用。: Fix: Apply marker changes through a confirmation panel.
feat: 新增「折設定」勾選框，可將 OpenAI API 參數區塊折疊收起，: Feature: Add a “Fold settings” checkbox for OpenAI API parameters, with its state stored in the browser.
fix: 修正重整頁面後資料夾設定、收合狀態、debug 等全部遺失的問題。: Fix: Preserve folder settings, collapsed states, debug settings, and other settings after a page refresh.
fix: 舊版設定資料會在存檔時自動轉換為新格式，無需手動處理。: Fix: Convert old settings to the new format automatically on save.
fix: 重設功能現在能正確清除所有設定。: Fix: Reset now clears all settings correctly.
feat: 預設匯出/匯入時自動同步摺疊配置。: Feature: Include folding settings when exporting and importing presets.
style: 舊版模式改為可折疊區塊，預設收起。: Style: Put legacy modes in a collapsible section, closed by default.
style: 移除套用按鈕，分隔符號改為失焦自動儲存。: Style: Remove the apply button and save markers on blur.
style: 重設按鈕移至右上角 icon。: Style: Move reset to the icon in the top right.
style: 作者連結加入 GitHub 超連結。: Style: Add a GitHub link for the author.
feat: 操作優化，具體體現在勾選時有確認或取消的浮動視窗可以跟著。: Feature: Add a floating panel to confirm or cancel selections.
輸入用於標識群組標題的符號或文字。:
Enter symbols or text identifying group headers.

Examples:
• “=” matches prompts starting with “=”
• “---” matches prompts starting with “---”
從其他預設設定檔複製摺疊配置到目前預設設定檔。:
Copy folding settings from another preset to the current preset.

Entries are matched by UUID; entries created from the same preset share UUIDs.
